query: UPDATE workspaces w SET state='deleted',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM conversations c JOIN agent_team_members m ON m.conversation_id=c.id WHERE c.id=$1 AND m.workspace='own_copy' AND w.id=c.workspace_id AND w.kind='helper_copy' AND w.state<>'deleted' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM conversations o WHERE o.workspace_id=w.id AND o.id<>c.id AND o.state<>'deleted')
